reason: The hypothesis directly restates the intervention, mechanism, and outcome reported in P25 and P6, which already demonstrated that substrate preheating (~500°C) reduces thermal gradients and suppresses cracking in additively manufactured HEAs. The proposal adds no new material, regime, or mechanistic insight beyond what these passages already describe as an effective strategy.
copied_elements: substrate preheating to reduce thermal gradients and cracking
mechanism: reduced cooling rate and thermal gradients minimize residual stress
predicted outcome: fewer cracks, less porosity, improved mechanical properties
